item.text: The gear appears to taper along the Y axis, with the larger end toward +Y. I’ll model 40 straight teeth, a small-end diameter about two-thirds of the large end, and a through bore with a keyway.
The toothed loft is still computing. Once it completes, I’ll add the bore and keyway and render the four views to check the taper and orientation.
The detailed tooth profiles are taking longer than expected to loft. I’m waiting for that operation to finish before making further edits.
I’m still waiting on the first loft. After it completes, the preview comparison will determine whether the diameter ratio and axial length need adjustment.

item.text: The full-profile loft timed out without saving changes. I’ll build a conical core, loft one tooth, and repeat it around the Y axis to produce the same overall shape with a simpler construction.

arguments.label: Forty teeth and keyed through bore
Forty teeth and keyed through bore

item.text: The first preview matches the taper and orientation closely. The reference appears to have fewer, deeper teeth, so I’ll revise the pattern to 32 teeth and round the tooth roots.

arguments.label: Refine tooth spacing and root shape

item.text: The revised model has 32 teeth and an enlarged keyed bore. AgentCAD reports one valid solid. I’ll check the final four-view preview and validation report, then export `submission.step`.
